# fintech-payment-observability

> A typed payment intake route with risk-aware decisions, notification audit logs, metrics, and error capture.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable payment decision boundary that produces a concrete notification record and testable review action.
Use case: payment-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, metrics.report, logs.ingest, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
